Implement RFC 6901 JSON Pointer resolution

Export resolvePointer(document, pointer) from src/index.ts, throwing on
invalid pointer syntax or on pointers that don't resolve to a value.
Adds typescript/@types/node as devDependencies and the tsconfig options
needed for Node's native .ts execution, plus a typecheck script.
